label: Stationed MAA pursuit %
summary: Changes the pursuit of men-at-arms stationed in the province, as a percentage.
details: Pursuit is one of the combat stats of men-at-arms regiments. The game's display name refers to the flat version, stationed men-at-arms pursuit. Works on a province.

label: Stationed MAA screen
summary: Adds a flat amount of screen to men-at-arms stationed in the province.
details: Screen is one of the combat stats of men-at-arms regiments. Works on a province.

label: Stationed MAA screen %
summary: Changes the screen of men-at-arms stationed in the province, as a percentage.
details: The percentage version of stationed men-at-arms screen. Works on a province.

label: Stationed MAA siege progress
summary: Adds a flat amount of siege progress to men-at-arms stationed in the province.
details: The game's own name for it is stationed men-at-arms siege progress. Works on a province.

label: Stationed MAA siege effectiveness
summary: Changes how effective the siege weapons of stationed men-at-arms are, as a percentage.
details: The game's display name is stationed men-at-arms siege weapon effectiveness. Works on a province.

label: Stationed MAA toughness
summary: Adds a flat amount of toughness to men-at-arms stationed in the province.
details: Toughness is one of the combat stats of men-at-arms regiments. Works on a province.

label: Stationed MAA toughness %
summary: Changes the toughness of men-at-arms stationed in the province, as a percentage.
details: The percentage version of stationed men-at-arms toughness. Works on a province.

label: MAA toughness % per piety
summary: Changes the toughness of men-at-arms stationed in the province by a percentage for each piety level.
details: Piety level is the tier of piety. Vanilla uses it in the province modifiers of temple citadel buildings, with values from 0.01 to 0.1 per level. The input does not say whose piety level counts. Works on a province.

label: Stewardship
summary: Adds a flat amount to the character's Stewardship skill.
details: A negative value lowers it. Works on a character.

label: Stewardship %
summary: Changes the character's Stewardship skill by a percentage.
details: The game gives it the same display name as the flat version. Works on a character.

label: Stewardship per influence level
summary: Adds Stewardship for each influence level the character has.
details: Influence level is the tier of the character's influence. The amount you write is added once per level. Works on a character.

label: Stewardship per merit level
summary: Adds Stewardship for each merit level the character has.
details: Merit level is the tier of the character's merit. The amount you write is added once per level. Works on a character.

label: Stewardship per piety level
summary: Adds Stewardship for each piety level the character has.
details: Piety level is the tier of the character's piety. The amount you write is added once per level. Works on a character.

label: Stewardship per prestige level
summary: Adds Stewardship for each prestige level the character has.
details: Prestige level is the tier of the character's prestige. The amount you write is added once per level. Works on a character.

label: Stewardship per stress level
summary: Adds Stewardship for each stress level the character has.
details: Stress level is the tier of the character's stress. The amount you write is added once per level, so a negative value gives a penalty that grows with stress. Works on a character.

label: Stewardship scheme speed
summary: Changes how long the phases of the character's Stewardship schemes take.
details: The game's display name is Stewardship scheme speed. The input does not say whether a positive value speeds schemes up or slows them down. Works on a character.

label: Stewardship scheme resistance
summary: Changes the character's Stewardship scheme resistance.
details: The game's display name is Stewardship scheme resistance. Going by the name, it works against Stewardship schemes aimed at the character. The unit and size are not given in the input. Works on a character.

label: Stress gain %
summary: Changes the stress the character gains, as a percentage.
details: A negative value means less stress is gained. Works on a character.

label: Stress loss %
summary: Changes the stress the character loses, as a percentage.
details: A positive value means stress goes down by more. Works on a character.

label: Stress loss per piety level
summary: Changes the character's stress loss for each piety level they have.
details: Piety level is the tier of the character's piety. The amount you write is applied once per level. Works on a character.

label: Stress loss per prestige level
summary: Changes the character's stress loss for each prestige level they have.
details: Prestige level is the tier of the character's prestige. The amount you write is applied once per level. Works on a character.

label: Strife opinion gain %
summary: Changes the strife gain of the character, as a percentage.
details: The game's display name is strife gain. The input does not explain what strife is or how the gain works; the key's name mentions opinion. Works on a character.

label: Strife opinion loss %
summary: Changes the strife loss of the character, as a percentage.
details: The game's display name is strife loss. The input does not explain what strife is or how the loss works; the key's name mentions opinion. Works on a character.

label: Subject salary expense
summary: Adds a flat amount to the subject salary expense of the character.
details: `$SUBJECT_SALARY$` stands for a title tier (county, duchy, kingdom, empire or hegemony) or nothing; vanilla defines gold versions for each. Vanilla shows the gold amounts as a monthly amount with two decimals. Going by the name, an expense is salary the character pays to subjects and an income is salary the character receives as a subject; the input does not state it. Works on a character.
